scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic for all positive integers, using the exact prime-factor formula for the arithmetic derivative, Euler's product formula, a closed two-prime-support identity, and a squarefree recursion. Computation through \(10^6\) is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the initial spectrum only through \(9\) and the first sharp support thresholds; arbitrary fibers and asymptotic distribution remain open. The canonical database entry was inspected, but an unindexed elementary note could still contain an equivalent classification.
title: Sharp support thresholds for the arithmetic-derivative cototient gap
